fieldExtractionLimits: Opaque Mixed/Object/Map containers require bounded recursive extraction in a separately authorized process; never export their raw content.
Text fields require local HTML/Markdown/CSS/URL token parsing. Values and customer/applicant/staff identifiers never leave that process.
Historical/unknown collections and out-of-schema legacy fields remain an evidence gap; current schemas cannot prove them absent.

captureContract.requiredScope: Separate read-only target/profile authorization, explicit collection/field allowlist, complete-capture metadata, bounded scans and a capture-local join key.
captureContract.coverage: Every selected field/collection must declare complete/partial/not-collected; malformed, bounded-out, unsupported and unknown values remain unresolved. No absence conclusion from partial evidence.
captureContract.opaqueFields: Future capture may read an allowlisted opaque field inside the authorized process to extract only reference tokens; if that cannot be bounded or minimized, leave it NOT_COLLECTED rather than exporting the object.
